description: Test vectors for the SentiLab view envelope, DRAFT v0.4 (view-envelope-0.4.md). Generated by `node run-view-vectors.mjs --write` and checked by `node run-view-vectors.mjs`. Each chain gives the core's input, the run the view requested, what the page pins and what keys it was served, the envelopes, a hand-written expect block, and the full verifyChain() result.

rules.canonical: canonical() from ../contract-0.2/resultcheck.mjs; for these values it equals RFC 8785 (JCS). Absent fields are omitted, never undefined or null
rules.hash: sha256(canonical(envelope without sig and hash)), lowercase hex, recomputed from the content by the verifier
rules.prev_hash: the stored hash of the previous envelope by seq; the first is sha256("sentilab-view-genesis:" + the run_id the view requested)
rules.run: an envelope whose run.run_id differs from the run the view requested is run_mismatch
rules.sig: Ed25519 over the 64 hex characters of the recomputed hash as UTF-8; sig.value is lowercase hex, 128 characters
rules.seq: 1, 2, 3, ... in seq order; equal to the previous is seq_repeat, anything else is seq_gap; only that envelope is flagged
rules.key_sha256: sha256 of the raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key (the last 32 bytes of its SPKI DER), lowercase hex
rules.projection: the projectable prefix is the longest run from seq 1 of rows that are verified and not oversize; prefix_end K is its last seq (0 if none); the board is project() over exactly those events; each row has projected true or false; when anything follows the prefix, frozen is true and label is "chain broken after seq K; board frozen at seq K", otherwise frozen is false and label is null; if project() throws, projection is null and projection_error is project_threw
rules.mode: api: LIVE when a poll succeeded within 5 s and a verified envelope arrived within 60 s (client clock, inclusive, never in the future), otherwise STALE; file: REPLAY
rules.roles: actor_role is lab, core or acceptance_gate; actor.lab gate goes with acceptance_gate; only the gate writes accepted, non_improving_current and within_margin
rules.test_keys: seed = sha256("sentilab-view-test-key:" + name) (32 bytes); private key = Ed25519 from that seed, i.e. PKCS8 DER 302e020100300506032b657004220420 || seed
rules.after_signing: set the value at path in the envelope with that seq, after it was signed
rules.replace_from_fork: build the same chain with entry fork_seq's ts set to fork_ts, then put that chain's envelope take_seq in place of ours
rules.append_checks: false means a faulty writer: makeChain skips the checks the core makes on append
rules.drop_seqs: sign the whole chain, then leave the envelopes with these seqs out of the file

reason_codes.malformed: required fields missing or the wrong type, or the hash can't be computed
reason_codes.run_mismatch: run.run_id differs from the run the view requested
reason_codes.seq_gap: seq is not the previous seq + 1 (or not 1 for the first)
reason_codes.prev_hash_mismatch: prev_hash is not the previous envelope's stored hash (or the genesis value)
reason_codes.hash_mismatch: the stored hash is not the hash recomputed from the content
reason_codes.key_not_pinned: sig.key_id is not among the page's pins
reason_codes.key_unavailable: pinned, but no key was served for that key_id
reason_codes.key_hash_mismatch: the served key's sha256 doesn't match the pin
reason_codes.bad_sig: the signature doesn't verify over the recomputed hash

cap_codes.too_large: canonical(envelope) is over 65,536 bytes (not evaluated when too_deep)
cap_codes.too_many_entries:<field>: over 64 entries in values.geometry, values.center_temps or values.artifact_hashes
cap_codes.string_too_long: a string or object key over 512 code points
cap_codes.non_finite_number: a number that is NaN or infinite
cap_codes.too_deep: an object or array below level 8, counting the envelope as level 1

caps.build: Start from the V1 envelope at seq 4. Set values.artifact_hashes to 64 strings of 512 'a', and values.geometry to 64 entries {id:'g<i>',xLL:0,yLL:0,w:1,h:1,layer:0}. Then append 'x' to geometry ids in order, each up to 512 characters, until canonical(envelope) is exactly target_bytes.

hashing.name: values absent, undefined and null: undefined and null both canonicalize to null, so neither hashes like absent
hashing.round_trip: sign the envelope with values: undefined in memory, then JSON.stringify and JSON.parse it, which drops the key

canonical.name: keys sorted, no whitespace, 5.0 written as 5
keys sorted by UTF-16 code units: U+1F600 (D83D DE00) sorts before U+FF21
strings as JSON.stringify: non-ASCII stays as is, control characters are escaped
